sources.snippet: Model Introduction Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct is an instruction-tuned Vision-Language Model (VLM) for understanding images, videos, and text. It combines a vision encoder with a dense autoregressive language model. The model supports visual question answering, multilingual OCR, document understanding, visual grounding, spatial reasoning, video understanding, visual coding, and visual-agent tasks.
